initialization.distribution: Independent uniform [-amplitude,+amplitude], joint positions clipped only to actual joint limits; no root height or external-force aid.
initialization.reset_model_revision: Ground root/leg/noise definitions unchanged; explicitly collision-free upright arm nominal. Source and native validation in full_racket_reset_v4.json.

launches: Exactly one active initial condition at t=2 s after explicit preparation. No post-launch ball state correction. Ball observations masked before active launch.
aggregation: Compute all ratios separately on each complete 200-case panel; use the worse panel for each threshold; retain every case and every numerical fault.

metrics.airborne_contact: Actual string force during measured flight and legal first own-side racket contact; later faults remain recorded.
metrics.conditional_recovery: Among airborne-contact episodes, original qualified-jump/continuous0.8s recovery and no rally-invalidating fault.
metrics.complete_success: Ground initialization AND legal airborne strings AND outgoing speed>=8 m/s,vx>0,vz<=-1 m/s AND actual over-net return AND first landing in target AND original recovery AND no fault.

law_source.version: BWF Laws of Badminton In Force 26 April 2025 V5.0(1)

engineering_constraints.body_proxy: Conservative body-local bounds of actual collider shapes; fixture is nonracket.
engineering_constraints.head_strings_same_stroke: Continuous contact episodes; frame+strings exception grouped within40ms, normal change<15deg and no head-velocity reversal. Engineering resolution, not BWF wording.
engineering_constraints.net: 64 GPU primitive strips, suspended band; rigid equivalent without cloth holes.
engineering_constraints.shuttle: Existing 5.2g sphere/radius25mm/uncalibrated quadratic drag; real-shuttle validation remains outside these simulation claims.
engineering_constraints.strings: 64 slices,62 nonempty thin primitive boxes inscribed in the same32gon. No outward face enlargement. String mass5g, combined inertia recomputed. Current collision/visual/audit use the same box union.

policy_lock: Freeze source SHA plus dirty snapshot, all physical hashes and weight SHA before launching formal panels; cases/thresholds never adjusted based on results.

revision_from.reason: Necessary model correctness repair: clamp4mm wrist penetration generates persistent21-36kN self contact in reset_self_contact01. R3 clamp clears wrist and upright ground reset has0N actual self contact in reset_self_contact_r3_01. No thresholds or incoming cases changed.
revision_from.prior_training_attempt: reach_cem_smoke01 on erroneous r2,32 candidates,0 recoveries; preserved and not used as r3 performance.
